links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM trial eligibility decisions versus two-oncologist consensus on synthetic patients
links.effect: 88% of 150 patient-trial eligibility decisions correct; 90% or greater accuracy in 5 of 10 trials; lower accuracy in more intricate protocols.
links.quote: Across 150 patient-trial evaluations, the model correctly classified 88% of overall eligibility decisions.

unlisted_practices: Synthetic patient data for evaluating clinical trial matching LLM
Time-to-verdict comparison of automated versus clinician trial eligibility screening

screen.reason: Evaluates a fine-tuned LLM (SROTAS IQ) on synthetic patient vignettes for clinical trial matching compared to oncologist ground truth, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
